description: Register an Apache Druid broker SQL HTTP API resource for use by other components

broker_url.label: Broker URL
broker_url.description: Base URL of the Druid broker, e.g. 'http://druid-broker:8082'.

username.label: Username
username.description: Basic auth username, if the broker requires it.

password_env_var.label: Password Env Var
password_env_var.description: Env var holding the basic auth password.

request_headers.label: Request Headers
request_headers.description: Extra HTTP headers, e.g. a bearer token if Druid sits behind an authenticating proxy.

resource_key.label: Resource Key
resource_key.description: Key used to register this resource. Other components reference it via resource_key.

name: Druid Resource
